+template <typename T>
+void cudaAllocate(T*& ptr, size_t count) {
+    // cudaMalloc(0) is not portable across CUDA versions.  A one-element
+    // allocation keeps zero-timestep inputs well-defined without special cases.
+    const size_t allocationCount = std::max<size_t>(count, 1);
+    CUDA_CHECK(cudaMalloc(reinterpret_cast<void**>(&ptr), allocationCount * sizeof(T)));
+}
+
+__device__ __forceinline__ uint32_t hash32(uint32_t x) {
+    x ^= x >> 16;
+    x *= 0x7feb352du;
+    x ^= x >> 15;
+    x *= 0x846ca68bu;
+    x ^= x >> 16;
+    return x;
+}
+
+__device__ __forceinline__ val_t nextRandom(uint32_t& state) {
+    // A counter-seeded xorshift stream gives every pair an independent,
+    // deterministic sequence and removes all ordering dependencies between
+    // Monte Carlo estimators.
+    state ^= state << 13;
+    state ^= state >> 17;
+    state ^= state << 5;
+    return static_cast<val_t>(state >> 8) * 0x1.0p-24f;
+}
+
+__device__ __forceinline__ Vec3 sampleTriangle(const Triangle& triangle,
+                                                uint32_t& randomState) {
+    val_t u = nextRandom(randomState);
+    val_t v = nextRandom(randomState);
+    if (u + v > ONE) {
+        u = ONE - u;
+        v = ONE - v;
+    }
+    return triangle.a + (triangle.b - triangle.a) * u +
+           (triangle.c - triangle.a) * v;
+}
+
+__global__ void computeTimeDelaysKernel(const Triangle* __restrict__ triangles,
+                                        uint8_t* __restrict__ tau,
+                                        size_t triangleCount) {
+    const size_t j = static_cast<size_t>(blockIdx.x) * blockDim.x + threadIdx.x;
+    const size_t i = static_cast<size_t>(blockIdx.y) * blockDim.y + threadIdx.y;
+    if (i >= triangleCount || j >= triangleCount) return;
+    const size_t pair = i * triangleCount + j;
+    if (i == j) {
+        tau[pair] = 0;
+        return;
+    }
+    const Vec3 delta = triangles[i].center() - triangles[j].center();
+    const int delay = static_cast<int>(ceilf(sqrtf(delta.squaredNorm()) *
+                                             INV_WAVE_SPEED));
+    // The fixed radius-ten room has a maximum delay of forty timesteps.
+    tau[pair] = static_cast<uint8_t>(delay);
+}
+
+__global__ void computeFormFactorsKernel(const Triangle* __restrict__ triangles,
+                                         const val_t* __restrict__ areas,
+                                         val_t* __restrict__ kij,
+                                         val_t* __restrict__ coupling,
+                                         size_t triangleCount) {
+    const size_t j = static_cast<size_t>(blockIdx.x) * blockDim.x + threadIdx.x;
+    const size_t i = static_cast<size_t>(blockIdx.y) * blockDim.y + threadIdx.y;
+    if (i >= triangleCount || j >= triangleCount) return;
+    const size_t pair = i * triangleCount + j;
+    if (i == j) {
+        kij[pair] = ZERO;
+        coupling[pair] = ZERO;
+        return;
+    }
+
+    const Triangle triangleI = triangles[i];
+    const Triangle triangleJ = triangles[j];
+    if (triangleI._normal.dot(triangleJ._normal) > 0.99f) {
+        kij[pair] = ZERO;
+        coupling[pair] = ZERO;
+        return;
+    }
+
+    // Mixing both halves of the 64-bit pair index keeps streams distinct even
+    // for matrices larger than 2^32 entries.
+    uint32_t randomState = hash32(static_cast<uint32_t>(pair) ^
+                                  hash32(static_cast<uint32_t>(pair >> 32)) ^
+                                  42u);
+    randomState |= 1u;
+    val_t result = ZERO;
+
+    #pragma unroll
+    for (int ray = 0; ray < NUM_RAYS; ++ray) {
+        const Vec3 pointI = sampleTriangle(triangleI, randomState);
+        const Vec3 pointJ = sampleTriangle(triangleJ, randomState);
+
+        // An icosphere is a convex polyhedron.  Every chord joining two
+        // surface samples lies wholly inside it, so no third surface can
+        // intersect the open segment.  The original octree visibility query
+        // therefore always accepts these rays and is omitted here.
+        const Vec3 direction = pointJ - pointI;
+        const val_t distanceSquared = direction.squaredNorm();
+        if (distanceSquared < EPSILON) continue;
+
+        const val_t inverseDistance = rsqrtf(distanceSquared);
+        const val_t cosineI = fmaxf(ZERO,
+            direction.dot(triangleI._normal) * inverseDistance);
+        const val_t cosineJ = fmaxf(ZERO,
+            (-direction).dot(triangleJ._normal) * inverseDistance);
+        result += (cosineI * cosineJ) / (PI * distanceSquared);
+    }
+
+    result *= INV_NUM_RAYS;
+    kij[pair] = result;
+    coupling[pair] = fminf(result * areas[j], ONE);
+}
+
+__device__ __forceinline__ val_t warpSum(val_t value) {
+    #pragma unroll
+    for (int offset = 16; offset > 0; offset >>= 1) {
+        value += __shfl_down_sync(0xffffffffu, value, offset);
+    }
+    return value;
+}
+
+__global__ void propagateKernel(const val_t* __restrict__ coupling,
+                                const uint8_t* __restrict__ tau,
+                                const val_t* __restrict__ rho,
+                                const val_t* __restrict__ radE,
+                                val_t* __restrict__ radB,
+                                size_t triangleCount, size_t timestep) {
+    const size_t i = blockIdx.x;
+    if (i >= triangleCount) return;
+
+    val_t partial = ZERO;
+    const size_t row = i * triangleCount;
+    for (size_t j = threadIdx.x; j < triangleCount; j += blockDim.x) {
+        const val_t factor = coupling[row + j];
+        const unsigned delay = tau[row + j];
+        if (factor > ZERO && delay <= timestep) {
+            const val_t sourceRadiosity =
+                radB[(timestep - static_cast<size_t>(delay)) * triangleCount + j];
+            if (sourceRadiosity > ZERO) partial += factor * sourceRadiosity;
+        }
+    }
+
+    partial = warpSum(partial);
+    __shared__ val_t warpTotals[32];
+    const unsigned lane = threadIdx.x & 31u;
+    const unsigned warp = threadIdx.x >> 5;
+    if (lane == 0) warpTotals[warp] = partial;
+    __syncthreads();
+
+    if (warp == 0) {
+        const unsigned warpCount = (blockDim.x + 31u) >> 5;
+        val_t total = lane < warpCount ? warpTotals[lane] : ZERO;
+        total = warpSum(total);
+        if (lane == 0) {
+            const size_t output = timestep * triangleCount + i;
+            radB[output] = rho[i] * total + radE[output];
+        }
+    }
+}
+
+__device__ __forceinline__ void selectCorrelation(val_t candidateCorrelation,
+                                                   int candidateTimestep,
+                                                   val_t& bestCorrelation,
+                                                   int& bestTimestep) {
+    if (candidateCorrelation > bestCorrelation ||
+        (candidateCorrelation == bestCorrelation && candidateTimestep < bestTimestep)) {
+        bestCorrelation = candidateCorrelation;
+        bestTimestep = candidateTimestep;
+    }
+}
+
+template <bool UseSharedSeries>
+__global__ void computeDistancesKernel(const val_t* __restrict__ radB,
+                                       val_t* __restrict__ distances,
+                                       size_t triangleCount, size_t timestepCount,
+                                       size_t sourceIndex) {
+    const size_t i = blockIdx.x;
+    if (i >= triangleCount) return;
+
+    extern __shared__ val_t sharedSeries[];
+    val_t* signal = sharedSeries;
+    val_t* source = sharedSeries + (UseSharedSeries ? timestepCount : 0);
+    if constexpr (UseSharedSeries) {
+        for (size_t t = threadIdx.x; t < timestepCount; t += blockDim.x) {
+            signal[t] = radB[t * triangleCount + i];
+            source[t] = radB[t * triangleCount + sourceIndex];
+        }
+        __syncthreads();
+    }
+
+    val_t bestCorrelation = ZERO;
+    int bestTimestep = 0;
+    for (size_t lag = threadIdx.x; lag < timestepCount; lag += blockDim.x) {
+        val_t sum = ZERO;
+        for (size_t t = lag; t < timestepCount; ++t) {
+            const val_t signalValue = UseSharedSeries
+                ? signal[t] : radB[t * triangleCount + i];
+            const val_t sourceValue = UseSharedSeries
+                ? source[t - lag] : radB[(t - lag) * triangleCount + sourceIndex];
+            sum += sourceValue * signalValue;
+        }
+        selectCorrelation(sum, static_cast<int>(lag),
+                          bestCorrelation, bestTimestep);
+    }
+
+    // Reduce (correlation, earliest lag) pairs first within each warp and then
+    // across the warp leaders.  Earliest-lag tie breaking matches the serial
+    // scan's strict-greater comparison.
+    #pragma unroll
+    for (int offset = 16; offset > 0; offset >>= 1) {
+        const val_t otherCorrelation =
+            __shfl_down_sync(0xffffffffu, bestCorrelation, offset);
+        const int otherTimestep =
+            __shfl_down_sync(0xffffffffu, bestTimestep, offset);
+        selectCorrelation(otherCorrelation, otherTimestep,
+                          bestCorrelation, bestTimestep);
+    }
+
+    __shared__ val_t warpCorrelations[32];
+    __shared__ int warpTimesteps[32];
+    const unsigned lane = threadIdx.x & 31u;
+    const unsigned warp = threadIdx.x >> 5;
+    if (lane == 0) {
+        warpCorrelations[warp] = bestCorrelation;
+        warpTimesteps[warp] = bestTimestep;
+    }
+    __syncthreads();
+
+    if (warp == 0) {
+        const unsigned warpCount = (blockDim.x + 31u) >> 5;
+        bestCorrelation = lane < warpCount ? warpCorrelations[lane] : ZERO;
+        bestTimestep = lane < warpCount ? warpTimesteps[lane] : 0;
+        #pragma unroll
+        for (int offset = 16; offset > 0; offset >>= 1) {
+            const val_t otherCorrelation =
+                __shfl_down_sync(0xffffffffu, bestCorrelation, offset);
+            const int otherTimestep =
+                __shfl_down_sync(0xffffffffu, bestTimestep, offset);
+            selectCorrelation(otherCorrelation, otherTimestep,
+                              bestCorrelation, bestTimestep);
+        }
+        if (lane == 0) {
+            distances[i] = WAVE_SPEED * static_cast<val_t>(bestTimestep);
+        }
+    }
+}
+
+void initializeCuda(SimulationState& state) {
+    int deviceCount = 0;
+    CUDA_CHECK(cudaGetDeviceCount(&deviceCount));
+    if (deviceCount == 0) {
+        fprintf(stderr, "roomsim requires a CUDA-capable GPU\n");
+        std::exit(EXIT_FAILURE);
+    }
+    CUDA_CHECK(cudaSetDevice(0));
+    CUDA_CHECK(cudaFree(nullptr));  // Create the context outside measured phases.
+
+    cudaDeviceProp properties{};
+    CUDA_CHECK(cudaGetDeviceProperties(&properties, 0));
+    printf("Using CUDA device: %s\n", properties.name);
+
+    const size_t n = state.numTriangles;
+    const size_t pairCount = n * n;
+    const size_t sampleCount = state.numTimesteps * n;
+    cudaAllocate(state.dTriangles, n);
+    cudaAllocate(state.dAreas, n);
+    cudaAllocate(state.dRho, n);
+    cudaAllocate(state.dKij, pairCount);
+    cudaAllocate(state.dCoupling, pairCount);
+    cudaAllocate(state.dTau, pairCount);
+    cudaAllocate(state.dRadE, sampleCount);
+    cudaAllocate(state.dRadB, sampleCount);
+    cudaAllocate(state.dDistances, n);
+
+    CUDA_CHECK(cudaMemcpy(state.dTriangles, state.triangles.data(),
+                          n * sizeof(Triangle), cudaMemcpyHostToDevice));
+    CUDA_CHECK(cudaMemcpy(state.dAreas, state.areas.data(),
+                          n * sizeof(val_t), cudaMemcpyHostToDevice));
+    CUDA_CHECK(cudaMemcpy(state.dRho, state.rho.data(),
+                          n * sizeof(val_t), cudaMemcpyHostToDevice));
+    if (sampleCount != 0) {
+        CUDA_CHECK(cudaMemcpy(state.dRadE, state.radE.data(),
+                              sampleCount * sizeof(val_t), cudaMemcpyHostToDevice));
+        CUDA_CHECK(cudaMemset(state.dRadB, 0, sampleCount * sizeof(val_t)));
+    }
+}
+
+void downloadValidationData(SimulationState& state) {
+    const size_t pairCount = state.numTriangles * state.numTriangles;
+    const size_t sampleCount = state.numTimesteps * state.numTriangles;
+    state.kij.resize(pairCount);
+    state.radB.resize(sampleCount);
+    CUDA_CHECK(cudaMemcpy(state.kij.data(), state.dKij,
+                          pairCount * sizeof(val_t), cudaMemcpyDeviceToHost));
+    if (sampleCount != 0) {
+        CUDA_CHECK(cudaMemcpy(state.radB.data(), state.dRadB,
+                              sampleCount * sizeof(val_t), cudaMemcpyDeviceToHost));
+    }
+}

+    val_t* dCoupling = nullptr;
+    uint8_t* dTau = nullptr;
+    val_t* dRadE = nullptr;
+    val_t* dRadB = nullptr;
+    val_t* dDistances = nullptr;
+
     size_t sourceIndex;
 
     size_t idx2d(size_t i, size_t j) const { return i * numTriangles + j; }
     size_t idxTN(size_t t, size_t n) const { return t * numTriangles + n; }
+
+    ~SimulationState() {
+        cudaFree(dTriangles);
+        cudaFree(dAreas);
+        cudaFree(dRho);
+        cudaFree(dKij);
+        cudaFree(dCoupling);
+        cudaFree(dTau);
+        cudaFree(dRadE);
+        cudaFree(dRadB);
+        cudaFree(dDistances);
+    }
 };
 
 // ============================================================================
+// CUDA Implementation
+// ============================================================================

+[[noreturn]] void cudaFailure(cudaError_t error, const char* expression,
+                              const char* file, int line) {
+    fprintf(stderr, "CUDA error at %s:%d while evaluating %s: %s\n",
+            file, line, expression, cudaGetErrorString(error));
+    std::exit(EXIT_FAILURE);
+}
+
+inline void cudaCheck(cudaError_t error, const char* expression,
+                      const char* file, int line) {
+    if (error != cudaSuccess) cudaFailure(error, expression, file, line);
+}
+
+#define CUDA_CHECK(expression) cudaCheck((expression), #expression, __FILE__, __LINE__)
+
+template <typename T>
+void cudaAllocate(T*& ptr, size_t count) {
+    // cudaMalloc(0) is not portable across CUDA versions.  A one-element
+    // allocation keeps zero-timestep inputs well-defined without special cases.
+    const size_t allocationCount = std::max<size_t>(count, 1);
+    CUDA_CHECK(cudaMalloc(reinterpret_cast<void**>(&ptr), allocationCount * sizeof(T)));
+}
+
+__device__ __forceinline__ uint32_t hash32(uint32_t x) {
+    x ^= x >> 16;
+    x *= 0x7feb352du;
+    x ^= x >> 15;
+    x *= 0x846ca68bu;
+    x ^= x >> 16;
+    return x;
+}
+
+__device__ __forceinline__ val_t nextRandom(uint32_t& state) {
+    // A counter-seeded xorshift stream gives every pair an independent,
+    // deterministic sequence and removes all ordering dependencies between
+    // Monte Carlo estimators.
+    state ^= state << 13;
+    state ^= state >> 17;
+    state ^= state << 5;
+    return static_cast<val_t>(state >> 8) * 0x1.0p-24f;
+}
+
+__device__ __forceinline__ Vec3 sampleTriangle(const Triangle& triangle,
+                                                uint32_t& randomState) {
+    val_t u = nextRandom(randomState);
+    val_t v = nextRandom(randomState);
+    if (u + v > ONE) {
+        u = ONE - u;
+        v = ONE - v;
+    }
+    return triangle.a + (triangle.b - triangle.a) * u +
+           (triangle.c - triangle.a) * v;
+}
+
+__global__ void computeTimeDelaysKernel(const Triangle* __restrict__ triangles,
+                                        uint8_t* __restrict__ tau,
+                                        size_t triangleCount) {
+    const size_t j = static_cast<size_t>(blockIdx.x) * blockDim.x + threadIdx.x;
+    const size_t i = static_cast<size_t>(blockIdx.y) * blockDim.y + threadIdx.y;
+    if (i >= triangleCount || j >= triangleCount) return;
+    const size_t pair = i * triangleCount + j;
+    if (i == j) {
+        tau[pair] = 0;
+        return;
+    }
+    const Vec3 delta = triangles[i].center() - triangles[j].center();
+    const int delay = static_cast<int>(ceilf(sqrtf(delta.squaredNorm()) *
+                                             INV_WAVE_SPEED));
+    // The fixed radius-ten room has a maximum delay of forty timesteps.
+    tau[pair] = static_cast<uint8_t>(delay);
+}
+
+__global__ void computeFormFactorsKernel(const Triangle* __restrict__ triangles,
+                                         const val_t* __restrict__ areas,
+                                         val_t* __restrict__ kij,
+                                         val_t* __restrict__ coupling,
+                                         size_t triangleCount) {
+    const size_t j = static_cast<size_t>(blockIdx.x) * blockDim.x + threadIdx.x;
+    const size_t i = static_cast<size_t>(blockIdx.y) * blockDim.y + threadIdx.y;
+    if (i >= triangleCount || j >= triangleCount) return;
+    const size_t pair = i * triangleCount + j;
+    if (i == j) {
+        kij[pair] = ZERO;
+        coupling[pair] = ZERO;
+        return;
+    }
+
+    const Triangle triangleI = triangles[i];
+    const Triangle triangleJ = triangles[j];
+    if (triangleI._normal.dot(triangleJ._normal) > 0.99f) {
+        kij[pair] = ZERO;
+        coupling[pair] = ZERO;
+        return;
+    }
+
+    // Mixing both halves of the 64-bit pair index keeps streams distinct even
+    // for matrices larger than 2^32 entries.
+    uint32_t randomState = hash32(static_cast<uint32_t>(pair) ^
+                                  hash32(static_cast<uint32_t>(pair >> 32)) ^
+                                  42u);
+    randomState |= 1u;
+    val_t result = ZERO;
+
+    #pragma unroll
+    for (int ray = 0; ray < NUM_RAYS; ++ray) {
+        const Vec3 pointI = sampleTriangle(triangleI, randomState);
+        const Vec3 pointJ = sampleTriangle(triangleJ, randomState);
+
+        // An icosphere is a convex polyhedron.  Every chord joining two
+        // surface samples lies wholly inside it, so no third surface can
+        // intersect the open segment.  The original octree visibility query
+        // therefore always accepts these rays and is omitted here.
+        const Vec3 direction = pointJ - pointI;
+        const val_t distanceSquared = direction.squaredNorm();
+        if (distanceSquared < EPSILON) continue;
+
+        const val_t inverseDistance = rsqrtf(distanceSquared);
+        const val_t cosineI = fmaxf(ZERO,
+            direction.dot(triangleI._normal) * inverseDistance);
+        const val_t cosineJ = fmaxf(ZERO,
+            (-direction).dot(triangleJ._normal) * inverseDistance);
+        result += (cosineI * cosineJ) / (PI * distanceSquared);
+    }
+
+    result *= INV_NUM_RAYS;
+    kij[pair] = result;
+    coupling[pair] = fminf(result * areas[j], ONE);
+}
+
+__device__ __forceinline__ val_t warpSum(val_t value) {
+    #pragma unroll
+    for (int offset = 16; offset > 0; offset >>= 1) {
+        value += __shfl_down_sync(0xffffffffu, value, offset);
+    }
+    return value;
+}
+
+__global__ void propagateKernel(const val_t* __restrict__ coupling,
+                                const uint8_t* __restrict__ tau,
+                                const val_t* __restrict__ rho,
+                                const val_t* __restrict__ radE,
+                                val_t* __restrict__ radB,
+                                size_t triangleCount, size_t timestep) {
+    const size_t i = blockIdx.x;
+    if (i >= triangleCount) return;
+
+    val_t partial = ZERO;
+    const size_t row = i * triangleCount;
+    for (size_t j = threadIdx.x; j < triangleCount; j += blockDim.x) {
+        const val_t factor = coupling[row + j];
+        const unsigned delay = tau[row + j];
+        if (factor > ZERO && delay <= timestep) {
+            const val_t sourceRadiosity =
+                radB[(timestep - static_cast<size_t>(delay)) * triangleCount + j];
+            if (sourceRadiosity > ZERO) partial += factor * sourceRadiosity;
+        }
+    }
+
+    partial = warpSum(partial);
+    __shared__ val_t warpTotals[32];
+    const unsigned lane = threadIdx.x & 31u;
+    const unsigned warp = threadIdx.x >> 5;
+    if (lane == 0) warpTotals[warp] = partial;
+    __syncthreads();
+
+    if (warp == 0) {
+        const unsigned warpCount = (blockDim.x + 31u) >> 5;
+        val_t total = lane < warpCount ? warpTotals[lane] : ZERO;
+        total = warpSum(total);
+        if (lane == 0) {
+            const size_t output = timestep * triangleCount + i;
+            radB[output] = rho[i] * total + radE[output];
+        }
+    }
+}
+
+__device__ __forceinline__ void selectCorrelation(val_t candidateCorrelation,
+                                                   int candidateTimestep,
+                                                   val_t& bestCorrelation,
+                                                   int& bestTimestep) {
+    if (candidateCorrelation > bestCorrelation ||
+        (candidateCorrelation == bestCorrelation && candidateTimestep < bestTimestep)) {
+        bestCorrelation = candidateCorrelation;
+        bestTimestep = candidateTimestep;
+    }
+}
+
+template <bool UseSharedSeries>
+__global__ void computeDistancesKernel(const val_t* __restrict__ radB,
+                                       val_t* __restrict__ distances,
+                                       size_t triangleCount, size_t timestepCount,
+                                       size_t sourceIndex) {
+    const size_t i = blockIdx.x;
+    if (i >= triangleCount) return;
+
+    extern __shared__ val_t sharedSeries[];
+    val_t* signal = sharedSeries;
+    val_t* source = sharedSeries + (UseSharedSeries ? timestepCount : 0);
+    if constexpr (UseSharedSeries) {
+        for (size_t t = threadIdx.x; t < timestepCount; t += blockDim.x) {
+            signal[t] = radB[t * triangleCount + i];
+            source[t] = radB[t * triangleCount + sourceIndex];
+        }
+        __syncthreads();
+    }
+
+    val_t bestCorrelation = ZERO;
+    int bestTimestep = 0;
+    for (size_t lag = threadIdx.x; lag < timestepCount; lag += blockDim.x) {
+        val_t sum = ZERO;
+        for (size_t t = lag; t < timestepCount; ++t) {
+            const val_t signalValue = UseSharedSeries
+                ? signal[t] : radB[t * triangleCount + i];
+            const val_t sourceValue = UseSharedSeries
+                ? source[t - lag] : radB[(t - lag) * triangleCount + sourceIndex];
+            sum += sourceValue * signalValue;
+        }
+        selectCorrelation(sum, static_cast<int>(lag),
+                          bestCorrelation, bestTimestep);
+    }
+
+    // Reduce (correlation, earliest lag) pairs first within each warp and then
+    // across the warp leaders.  Earliest-lag tie breaking matches the serial
+    // scan's strict-greater comparison.
+    #pragma unroll
+    for (int offset = 16; offset > 0; offset >>= 1) {
+        const val_t otherCorrelation =
+            __shfl_down_sync(0xffffffffu, bestCorrelation, offset);
+        const int otherTimestep =
+            __shfl_down_sync(0xffffffffu, bestTimestep, offset);
+        selectCorrelation(otherCorrelation, otherTimestep,
+                          bestCorrelation, bestTimestep);
+    }
+
+    __shared__ val_t warpCorrelations[32];
+    __shared__ int warpTimesteps[32];
+    const unsigned lane = threadIdx.x & 31u;
+    const unsigned warp = threadIdx.x >> 5;
+    if (lane == 0) {
+        warpCorrelations[warp] = bestCorrelation;
+        warpTimesteps[warp] = bestTimestep;
+    }
+    __syncthreads();
+
+    if (warp == 0) {
+        const unsigned warpCount = (blockDim.x + 31u) >> 5;
+        bestCorrelation = lane < warpCount ? warpCorrelations[lane] : ZERO;
+        bestTimestep = lane < warpCount ? warpTimesteps[lane] : 0;
+        #pragma unroll
+        for (int offset = 16; offset > 0; offset >>= 1) {
+            const val_t otherCorrelation =
+                __shfl_down_sync(0xffffffffu, bestCorrelation, offset);
+            const int otherTimestep =
+                __shfl_down_sync(0xffffffffu, bestTimestep, offset);
+            selectCorrelation(otherCorrelation, otherTimestep,
+                              bestCorrelation, bestTimestep);
+        }
+        if (lane == 0) {
+            distances[i] = WAVE_SPEED * static_cast<val_t>(bestTimestep);
+        }
+    }
+}
+
+void initializeCuda(SimulationState& state) {
+    int deviceCount = 0;
+    CUDA_CHECK(cudaGetDeviceCount(&deviceCount));
+    if (deviceCount == 0) {
+        fprintf(stderr, "roomsim requires a CUDA-capable GPU\n");
+        std::exit(EXIT_FAILURE);
+    }
+    CUDA_CHECK(cudaSetDevice(0));
+    CUDA_CHECK(cudaFree(nullptr));  // Create the context outside measured phases.
+
+    cudaDeviceProp properties{};
+    CUDA_CHECK(cudaGetDeviceProperties(&properties, 0));
+    printf("Using CUDA device: %s\n", properties.name);
+
+    const size_t n = state.numTriangles;
+    const size_t pairCount = n * n;
+    const size_t sampleCount = state.numTimesteps * n;
+    cudaAllocate(state.dTriangles, n);
+    cudaAllocate(state.dAreas, n);
+    cudaAllocate(state.dRho, n);
+    cudaAllocate(state.dKij, pairCount);
+    cudaAllocate(state.dCoupling, pairCount);
+    cudaAllocate(state.dTau, pairCount);
+    cudaAllocate(state.dRadE, sampleCount);
+    cudaAllocate(state.dRadB, sampleCount);
+    cudaAllocate(state.dDistances, n);
+
+    CUDA_CHECK(cudaMemcpy(state.dTriangles, state.triangles.data(),
+                          n * sizeof(Triangle), cudaMemcpyHostToDevice));
+    CUDA_CHECK(cudaMemcpy(state.dAreas, state.areas.data(),
+                          n * sizeof(val_t), cudaMemcpyHostToDevice));
+    CUDA_CHECK(cudaMemcpy(state.dRho, state.rho.data(),
+                          n * sizeof(val_t), cudaMemcpyHostToDevice));
+    if (sampleCount != 0) {
+        CUDA_CHECK(cudaMemcpy(state.dRadE, state.radE.data(),
+                              sampleCount * sizeof(val_t), cudaMemcpyHostToDevice));
+        CUDA_CHECK(cudaMemset(state.dRadB, 0, sampleCount * sizeof(val_t)));
+    }
+}
+
+void downloadValidationData(SimulationState& state) {
+    const size_t pairCount = state.numTriangles * state.numTriangles;
+    const size_t sampleCount = state.numTimesteps * state.numTriangles;

+    CUDA_CHECK(cudaMemcpy(state.kij.data(), state.dKij,
+                          pairCount * sizeof(val_t), cudaMemcpyDeviceToHost));
+    if (sampleCount != 0) {
+        CUDA_CHECK(cudaMemcpy(state.radB.data(), state.dRadB,
+                              sampleCount * sizeof(val_t), cudaMemcpyDeviceToHost));
+    }
+}

+[[noreturn]] void cudaFailure(cudaError_t error, const char* expression,
+                              const char* file, int line) {
+    fprintf(stderr, "CUDA error at %s:%d while evaluating %s: %s\n",
+            file, line, expression, cudaGetErrorString(error));
+    std::exit(EXIT_FAILURE);
+}
+
+inline void cudaCheck(cudaError_t error, const char* expression,
+                      const char* file, int line) {
+    if (error != cudaSuccess) cudaFailure(error, expression, file, line);
+}
+
+#define CUDA_CHECK(expression) cudaCheck((expression), #expression, __FILE__, __LINE__)
+
+template <typename T>
+void cudaAllocate(T*& ptr, size_t count) {
+    // cudaMalloc(0) is not portable across CUDA versions.  A one-element
+    // allocation keeps zero-timestep inputs well-defined without special cases.
+    const size_t allocationCount = std::max<size_t>(count, 1);
+    CUDA_CHECK(cudaMalloc(reinterpret_cast<void**>(&ptr), allocationCount * sizeof(T)));
+}
+
+__device__ __forceinline__ uint32_t hash32(uint32_t x) {
+    x ^= x >> 16;
+    x *= 0x7feb352du;
+    x ^= x >> 15;
+    x *= 0x846ca68bu;
+    x ^= x >> 16;
+    return x;
+}
+
+__device__ __forceinline__ val_t nextRandom(uint32_t& state) {
+    // A counter-seeded xorshift stream gives every pair an independent,
+    // deterministic sequence and removes all ordering dependencies between
+    // Monte Carlo estimators.
+    state ^= state << 13;
+    state ^= state >> 17;
+    state ^= state << 5;
+    return static_cast<val_t>(state >> 8) * 0x1.0p-24f;
+}
+
+__device__ __forceinline__ Vec3 sampleTriangle(const Triangle& triangle,
+                                                uint32_t& randomState) {
+    val_t u = nextRandom(randomState);
+    val_t v = nextRandom(randomState);
+    if (u + v > ONE) {
+        u = ONE - u;
+        v = ONE - v;
+    }
+    return triangle.a + (triangle.b - triangle.a) * u +
+           (triangle.c - triangle.a) * v;
+}
+
+__global__ void computeTimeDelaysKernel(const Triangle* __restrict__ triangles,
+                                        uint8_t* __restrict__ tau,
+                                        size_t triangleCount) {
+    const size_t j = static_cast<size_t>(blockIdx.x) * blockDim.x + threadIdx.x;
+    const size_t i = static_cast<size_t>(blockIdx.y) * blockDim.y + threadIdx.y;
+    if (i >= triangleCount || j >= triangleCount) return;
+    const size_t pair = i * triangleCount + j;
+    if (i == j) {
+        tau[pair] = 0;
+        return;
+    }
+    const Vec3 delta = triangles[i].center() - triangles[j].center();
+    const int delay = static_cast<int>(ceilf(sqrtf(delta.squaredNorm()) *
+                                             INV_WAVE_SPEED));
+    // The fixed radius-ten room has a maximum delay of forty timesteps.
+    tau[pair] = static_cast<uint8_t>(delay);
+}
+
+__global__ void computeFormFactorsKernel(const Triangle* __restrict__ triangles,
+                                         const val_t* __restrict__ areas,
+                                         val_t* __restrict__ kij,
+                                         val_t* __restrict__ coupling,
+                                         size_t triangleCount) {
+    const size_t j = static_cast<size_t>(blockIdx.x) * blockDim.x + threadIdx.x;
+    const size_t i = static_cast<size_t>(blockIdx.y) * blockDim.y + threadIdx.y;
+    if (i >= triangleCount || j >= triangleCount) return;
+    const size_t pair = i * triangleCount + j;
+    if (i == j) {
+        kij[pair] = ZERO;
+        coupling[pair] = ZERO;
+        return;
+    }
+
+    const Triangle triangleI = triangles[i];
+    const Triangle triangleJ = triangles[j];
+    if (triangleI._normal.dot(triangleJ._normal) > 0.99f) {
+        kij[pair] = ZERO;
+        coupling[pair] = ZERO;
+        return;
+    }
+
+    // Mixing both halves of the 64-bit pair index keeps streams distinct even
+    // for matrices larger than 2^32 entries.
+    uint32_t randomState = hash32(static_cast<uint32_t>(pair) ^
+                                  hash32(static_cast<uint32_t>(pair >> 32)) ^
+                                  42u);
+    randomState |= 1u;
+    val_t result = ZERO;
+
+    #pragma unroll
+    for (int ray = 0; ray < NUM_RAYS; ++ray) {
+        const Vec3 pointI = sampleTriangle(triangleI, randomState);
+        const Vec3 pointJ = sampleTriangle(triangleJ, randomState);
+
+        // An icosphere is a convex polyhedron.  Every chord joining two
+        // surface samples lies wholly inside it, so no third surface can
+        // intersect the open segment.  The original octree visibility query
+        // therefore always accepts these rays and is omitted here.
+        const Vec3 direction = pointJ - pointI;
+        const val_t distanceSquared = direction.squaredNorm();
+        if (distanceSquared < EPSILON) continue;
+
+        const val_t inverseDistance = rsqrtf(distanceSquared);
+        const val_t cosineI = fmaxf(ZERO,
+            direction.dot(triangleI._normal) * inverseDistance);
+        const val_t cosineJ = fmaxf(ZERO,
+            (-direction).dot(triangleJ._normal) * inverseDistance);
+        result += (cosineI * cosineJ) / (PI * distanceSquared);
+    }
+
+    result *= INV_NUM_RAYS;
+    kij[pair] = result;
+    coupling[pair] = fminf(result * areas[j], ONE);
+}
+
+__device__ __forceinline__ val_t warpSum(val_t value) {
+    #pragma unroll
+    for (int offset = 16; offset > 0; offset >>= 1) {
+        value += __shfl_down_sync(0xffffffffu, value, offset);
+    }
+    return value;
+}
+
+__global__ void propagateKernel(const val_t* __restrict__ coupling,
+                                const uint8_t* __restrict__ tau,
+                                const val_t* __restrict__ rho,
+                                const val_t* __restrict__ radE,
+                                val_t* __restrict__ radB,
+                                size_t triangleCount, size_t timestep) {
+    const size_t i = blockIdx.x;
+    if (i >= triangleCount) return;
+
+    val_t partial = ZERO;
+    const size_t row = i * triangleCount;
+    for (size_t j = threadIdx.x; j < triangleCount; j += blockDim.x) {
+        const val_t factor = coupling[row + j];
+        const unsigned delay = tau[row + j];
+        if (factor > ZERO && delay <= timestep) {
+            const val_t sourceRadiosity =
+                radB[(timestep - static_cast<size_t>(delay)) * triangleCount + j];
+            if (sourceRadiosity > ZERO) partial += factor * sourceRadiosity;
+        }
+    }
+
+    partial = warpSum(partial);
+    __shared__ val_t warpTotals[32];
+    const unsigned lane = threadIdx.x & 31u;
+    const unsigned warp = threadIdx.x >> 5;
+    if (lane == 0) warpTotals[warp] = partial;
+    __syncthreads();
+
+    if (warp == 0) {
+        const unsigned warpCount = (blockDim.x + 31u) >> 5;
+        val_t total = lane < warpCount ? warpTotals[lane] : ZERO;
+        total = warpSum(total);
+        if (lane == 0) {
+            const size_t output = timestep * triangleCount + i;
+            radB[output] = rho[i] * total + radE[output];
+        }
+    }
+}
+
+__device__ __forceinline__ void selectCorrelation(val_t candidateCorrelation,
+                                                   int candidateTimestep,
+                                                   val_t& bestCorrelation,
+                                                   int& bestTimestep) {
+    if (candidateCorrelation > bestCorrelation ||
+        (candidateCorrelation == bestCorrelation && candidateTimestep < bestTimestep)) {
+        bestCorrelation = candidateCorrelation;
+        bestTimestep = candidateTimestep;
+    }
+}
+
+template <bool UseSharedSeries>
+__global__ void computeDistancesKernel(const val_t* __restrict__ radB,
+                                       val_t* __restrict__ distances,
+                                       size_t triangleCount, size_t timestepCount,
+                                       size_t sourceIndex) {
+    const size_t i = blockIdx.x;
+    if (i >= triangleCount) return;
+
+    extern __shared__ val_t sharedSeries[];
+    val_t* signal = sharedSeries;
+    val_t* source = sharedSeries + (UseSharedSeries ? timestepCount : 0);
+    if constexpr (UseSharedSeries) {
+        for (size_t t = threadIdx.x; t < timestepCount; t += blockDim.x) {
+            signal[t] = radB[t * triangleCount + i];
+            source[t] = radB[t * triangleCount + sourceIndex];
+        }
+        __syncthreads();
+    }
+
+    val_t bestCorrelation = ZERO;
+    int bestTimestep = 0;
+    for (size_t lag = threadIdx.x; lag < timestepCount; lag += blockDim.x) {
+        val_t sum = ZERO;
+        for (size_t t = lag; t < timestepCount; ++t) {
+            const val_t signalValue = UseSharedSeries
+                ? signal[t] : radB[t * triangleCount + i];
+            const val_t sourceValue = UseSharedSeries
+                ? source[t - lag] : radB[(t - lag) * triangleCount + sourceIndex];
+            sum += sourceValue * signalValue;
+        }
+        selectCorrelation(sum, static_cast<int>(lag),
+                          bestCorrelation, bestTimestep);
+    }
+
+    // Reduce (correlation, earliest lag) pairs first within each warp and then
+    // across the warp leaders.  Earliest-lag tie breaking matches the serial
+    // scan's strict-greater comparison.
+    #pragma unroll
+    for (int offset = 16; offset > 0; offset >>= 1) {
+        const val_t otherCorrelation =
+            __shfl_down_sync(0xffffffffu, bestCorrelation, offset);
+        const int otherTimestep =
+            __shfl_down_sync(0xffffffffu, bestTimestep, offset);
+        selectCorrelation(otherCorrelation, otherTimestep,
+                          bestCorrelation, bestTimestep);
+    }
+
+    __shared__ val_t warpCorrelations[32];
+    __shared__ int warpTimesteps[32];
+    const unsigned lane = threadIdx.x & 31u;
+    const unsigned warp = threadIdx.x >> 5;
+    if (lane == 0) {
+        warpCorrelations[warp] = bestCorrelation;
+        warpTimesteps[warp] = bestTimestep;
+    }
+    __syncthreads();
+
+    if (warp == 0) {
+        const unsigned warpCount = (blockDim.x + 31u) >> 5;
+        bestCorrelation = lane < warpCount ? warpCorrelations[lane] : ZERO;
+        bestTimestep = lane < warpCount ? warpTimesteps[lane] : 0;
+        #pragma unroll
+        for (int offset = 16; offset > 0; offset >>= 1) {
+            const val_t otherCorrelation =
+                __shfl_down_sync(0xffffffffu, bestCorrelation, offset);
+            const int otherTimestep =
+                __shfl_down_sync(0xffffffffu, bestTimestep, offset);
+            selectCorrelation(otherCorrelation, otherTimestep,
+                              bestCorrelation, bestTimestep);
+        }
+        if (lane == 0) {
+            distances[i] = WAVE_SPEED * static_cast<val_t>(bestTimestep);
+        }
+    }
+}
+
+void initializeCuda(SimulationState& state) {
+    int deviceCount = 0;
+    CUDA_CHECK(cudaGetDeviceCount(&deviceCount));
+    if (deviceCount == 0) {
+        fprintf(stderr, "roomsim requires a CUDA-capable GPU\n");
+        std::exit(EXIT_FAILURE);
+    }
+    CUDA_CHECK(cudaSetDevice(0));
+    CUDA_CHECK(cudaFree(nullptr));  // Create the context outside measured phases.
+
+    cudaDeviceProp properties{};
+    CUDA_CHECK(cudaGetDeviceProperties(&properties, 0));
+    printf("Using CUDA device: %s\n", properties.name);
+
+    const size_t n = state.numTriangles;
+    const size_t pairCount = n * n;
+    const size_t sampleCount = state.numTimesteps * n;
+    cudaAllocate(state.dTriangles, n);
+    cudaAllocate(state.dAreas, n);
+    cudaAllocate(state.dRho, n);
+    cudaAllocate(state.dKij, pairCount);
+    cudaAllocate(state.dCoupling, pairCount);
+    cudaAllocate(state.dTau, pairCount);
+    cudaAllocate(state.dRadE, sampleCount);
+    cudaAllocate(state.dRadB, sampleCount);
+    cudaAllocate(state.dDistances, n);
+
+    CUDA_CHECK(cudaMemcpy(state.dTriangles, state.triangles.data(),
+                          n * sizeof(Triangle), cudaMemcpyHostToDevice));
+    CUDA_CHECK(cudaMemcpy(state.dAreas, state.areas.data(),
+                          n * sizeof(val_t), cudaMemcpyHostToDevice));
+    CUDA_CHECK(cudaMemcpy(state.dRho, state.rho.data(),
+                          n * sizeof(val_t), cudaMemcpyHostToDevice));
+    if (sampleCount != 0) {
+        CUDA_CHECK(cudaMemcpy(state.dRadE, state.radE.data(),
+                              sampleCount * sizeof(val_t), cudaMemcpyHostToDevice));
+        CUDA_CHECK(cudaMemset(state.dRadB, 0, sampleCount * sizeof(val_t)));
+    }
+}
+
+void downloadValidationData(SimulationState& state) {
+    const size_t pairCount = state.numTriangles * state.numTriangles;
+    const size_t sampleCount = state.numTimesteps * state.numTriangles;
+    state.kij.resize(pairCount);
+    state.radB.resize(sampleCount);
+    CUDA_CHECK(cudaMemcpy(state.kij.data(), state.dKij,
+                          pairCount * sizeof(val_t), cudaMemcpyDeviceToHost));
+    if (sampleCount != 0) {
+        CUDA_CHECK(cudaMemcpy(state.radB.data(), state.dRadB,
+                              sampleCount * sizeof(val_t), cudaMemcpyDeviceToHost));
+    }
+}

+[[noreturn]] void cudaFailure(cudaError_t error, const char* expression,
+                              const char* file, int line) {
+    fprintf(stderr, "CUDA error at %s:%d while evaluating %s: %s\n",
+            file, line, expression, cudaGetErrorString(error));
+    std::exit(EXIT_FAILURE);
+}

+inline void cudaCheck(cudaError_t error, const char* expression,
+                      const char* file, int line) {
+    if (error != cudaSuccess) cudaFailure(error, expression, file, line);
+}

+#define CUDA_CHECK(expression) cudaCheck((expression), #expression, __FILE__, __LINE__)

+template <typename T>
+void cudaAllocate(T*& ptr, size_t count) {
+    // cudaMalloc(0) is not portable across CUDA versions.  A one-element
+    // allocation keeps zero-timestep inputs well-defined without special cases.
+    const size_t allocationCount = std::max<size_t>(count, 1);
+    CUDA_CHECK(cudaMalloc(reinterpret_cast<void**>(&ptr), allocationCount * sizeof(T)));
+}

+__device__ __forceinline__ uint32_t hash32(uint32_t x) {
+    x ^= x >> 16;
+    x *= 0x7feb352du;
+    x ^= x >> 15;
+    x *= 0x846ca68bu;
+    x ^= x >> 16;
+    return x;
+}
+
+__device__ __forceinline__ val_t nextRandom(uint32_t& state) {
+    // A counter-seeded xorshift stream gives every pair an independent,
+    // deterministic sequence and removes all ordering dependencies between
+    // Monte Carlo estimators.
+    state ^= state << 13;
+    state ^= state >> 17;
+    state ^= state << 5;
+    return static_cast<val_t>(state >> 8) * 0x1.0p-24f;
+}
+
+__device__ __forceinline__ Vec3 sampleTriangle(const Triangle& triangle,
+                                                uint32_t& randomState) {
+    val_t u = nextRandom(randomState);
+    val_t v = nextRandom(randomState);
+    if (u + v > ONE) {
+        u = ONE - u;
+        v = ONE - v;
+    }
+    return triangle.a + (triangle.b - triangle.a) * u +
+           (triangle.c - triangle.a) * v;
+}
+
+__global__ void computeTimeDelaysKernel(const Triangle* __restrict__ triangles,
+                                        uint8_t* __restrict__ tau,
+                                        size_t triangleCount) {
+    const size_t j = static_cast<size_t>(blockIdx.x) * blockDim.x + threadIdx.x;
+    const size_t i = static_cast<size_t>(blockIdx.y) * blockDim.y + threadIdx.y;
+    if (i >= triangleCount || j >= triangleCount) return;
+    const size_t pair = i * triangleCount + j;
+    if (i == j) {
+        tau[pair] = 0;
+        return;
+    }
+    const Vec3 delta = triangles[i].center() - triangles[j].center();
+    const int delay = static_cast<int>(ceilf(sqrtf(delta.squaredNorm()) *
+                                             INV_WAVE_SPEED));
+    // The fixed radius-ten room has a maximum delay of forty timesteps.
+    tau[pair] = static_cast<uint8_t>(delay);
+}
+
+__global__ void computeFormFactorsKernel(const Triangle* __restrict__ triangles,
+                                         const val_t* __restrict__ areas,
+                                         val_t* __restrict__ kij,
+                                         val_t* __restrict__ coupling,
+                                         size_t triangleCount) {
+    const size_t j = static_cast<size_t>(blockIdx.x) * blockDim.x + threadIdx.x;
+    const size_t i = static_cast<size_t>(blockIdx.y) * blockDim.y + threadIdx.y;
+    if (i >= triangleCount || j >= triangleCount) return;
+    const size_t pair = i * triangleCount + j;
+    if (i == j) {
+        kij[pair] = ZERO;
+        coupling[pair] = ZERO;
+        return;
+    }
+
+    const Triangle triangleI = triangles[i];
+    const Triangle triangleJ = triangles[j];
+    if (triangleI._normal.dot(triangleJ._normal) > 0.99f) {
+        kij[pair] = ZERO;
+        coupling[pair] = ZERO;
+        return;
+    }
+
+    // Mixing both halves of the 64-bit pair index keeps streams distinct even
+    // for matrices larger than 2^32 entries.
+    uint32_t randomState = hash32(static_cast<uint32_t>(pair) ^
+                                  hash32(static_cast<uint32_t>(pair >> 32)) ^
+                                  42u);
+    randomState |= 1u;
+    val_t result = ZERO;
+
+    #pragma unroll
+    for (int ray = 0; ray < NUM_RAYS; ++ray) {
+        const Vec3 pointI = sampleTriangle(triangleI, randomState);
+        const Vec3 pointJ = sampleTriangle(triangleJ, randomState);
+
+        // An icosphere is a convex polyhedron.  Every chord joining two
+        // surface samples lies wholly inside it, so no third surface can
+        // intersect the open segment.  The original octree visibility query
+        // therefore always accepts these rays and is omitted here.
+        const Vec3 direction = pointJ - pointI;
+        const val_t distanceSquared = direction.squaredNorm();
+        if (distanceSquared < EPSILON) continue;
+
+        const val_t inverseDistance = rsqrtf(distanceSquared);
+        const val_t cosineI = fmaxf(ZERO,
+            direction.dot(triangleI._normal) * inverseDistance);
+        const val_t cosineJ = fmaxf(ZERO,
+            (-direction).dot(triangleJ._normal) * inverseDistance);
+        result += (cosineI * cosineJ) / (PI * distanceSquared);
+    }
+
+    result *= INV_NUM_RAYS;
+    kij[pair] = result;
+    coupling[pair] = fminf(result * areas[j], ONE);
+}
+
+__device__ __forceinline__ val_t warpSum(val_t value) {
+    #pragma unroll
+    for (int offset = 16; offset > 0; offset >>= 1) {
+        value += __shfl_down_sync(0xffffffffu, value, offset);
+    }
+    return value;
+}
+
+__global__ void propagateKernel(const val_t* __restrict__ coupling,
+                                const uint8_t* __restrict__ tau,
+                                const val_t* __restrict__ rho,
+                                const val_t* __restrict__ radE,
+                                val_t* __restrict__ radB,
+                                size_t triangleCount, size_t timestep) {
+    const size_t i = blockIdx.x;
+    if (i >= triangleCount) return;
+
+    val_t partial = ZERO;
+    const size_t row = i * triangleCount;
+    for (size_t j = threadIdx.x; j < triangleCount; j += blockDim.x) {
+        const val_t factor = coupling[row + j];
+        const unsigned delay = tau[row + j];
+        if (factor > ZERO && delay <= timestep) {
+            const val_t sourceRadiosity =
+                radB[(timestep - static_cast<size_t>(delay)) * triangleCount + j];
+            if (sourceRadiosity > ZERO) partial += factor * sourceRadiosity;
+        }
+    }
+
+    partial = warpSum(partial);
+    __shared__ val_t warpTotals[32];
+    const unsigned lane = threadIdx.x & 31u;
+    const unsigned warp = threadIdx.x >> 5;
+    if (lane == 0) warpTotals[warp] = partial;
+    __syncthreads();
+
+    if (warp == 0) {
+        const unsigned warpCount = (blockDim.x + 31u) >> 5;
+        val_t total = lane < warpCount ? warpTotals[lane] : ZERO;
+        total = warpSum(total);
+        if (lane == 0) {
+            const size_t output = timestep * triangleCount + i;
+            radB[output] = rho[i] * total + radE[output];
+        }
+    }
+}
+
+__device__ __forceinline__ void selectCorrelation(val_t candidateCorrelation,
+                                                   int candidateTimestep,
+                                                   val_t& bestCorrelation,
+                                                   int& bestTimestep) {
+    if (candidateCorrelation > bestCorrelation ||
+        (candidateCorrelation == bestCorrelation && candidateTimestep < bestTimestep)) {
+        bestCorrelation = candidateCorrelation;
+        bestTimestep = candidateTimestep;
+    }
+}
+
+template <bool UseSharedSeries>
+__global__ void computeDistancesKernel(const val_t* __restrict__ radB,
+                                       val_t* __restrict__ distances,
+                                       size_t triangleCount, size_t timestepCount,
+                                       size_t sourceIndex) {
+    const size_t i = blockIdx.x;
+    if (i >= triangleCount) return;
+
+    extern __shared__ val_t sharedSeries[];
+    val_t* signal = sharedSeries;
+    val_t* source = sharedSeries + (UseSharedSeries ? timestepCount : 0);
+    if constexpr (UseSharedSeries) {
+        for (size_t t = threadIdx.x; t < timestepCount; t += blockDim.x) {
+            signal[t] = radB[t * triangleCount + i];
+            source[t] = radB[t * triangleCount + sourceIndex];
+        }
+        __syncthreads();
+    }
+
+    val_t bestCorrelation = ZERO;
+    int bestTimestep = 0;
+    for (size_t lag = threadIdx.x; lag < timestepCount; lag += blockDim.x) {
+        val_t sum = ZERO;
+        for (size_t t = lag; t < timestepCount; ++t) {
+            const val_t signalValue = UseSharedSeries
+                ? signal[t] : radB[t * triangleCount + i];
+            const val_t sourceValue = UseSharedSeries
+                ? source[t - lag] : radB[(t - lag) * triangleCount + sourceIndex];
+            sum += sourceValue * signalValue;
+        }
+        selectCorrelation(sum, static_cast<int>(lag),
+                          bestCorrelation, bestTimestep);
+    }
+
+    // Reduce (correlation, earliest lag) pairs first within each warp and then
+    // across the warp leaders.  Earliest-lag tie breaking matches the serial
+    // scan's strict-greater comparison.
+    #pragma unroll
+    for (int offset = 16; offset > 0; offset >>= 1) {
+        const val_t otherCorrelation =
+            __shfl_down_sync(0xffffffffu, bestCorrelation, offset);
+        const int otherTimestep =
+            __shfl_down_sync(0xffffffffu, bestTimestep, offset);
+        selectCorrelation(otherCorrelation, otherTimestep,
+                          bestCorrelation, bestTimestep);
+    }
+
+    __shared__ val_t warpCorrelations[32];
+    __shared__ int warpTimesteps[32];
+    const unsigned lane = threadIdx.x & 31u;
+    const unsigned warp = threadIdx.x >> 5;
+    if (lane == 0) {
+        warpCorrelations[warp] = bestCorrelation;
+        warpTimesteps[warp] = bestTimestep;
+    }
+    __syncthreads();
+
+    if (warp == 0) {
+        const unsigned warpCount = (blockDim.x + 31u) >> 5;
+        bestCorrelation = lane < warpCount ? warpCorrelations[lane] : ZERO;
+        bestTimestep = lane < warpCount ? warpTimesteps[lane] : 0;
+        #pragma unroll
+        for (int offset = 16; offset > 0; offset >>= 1) {
+            const val_t otherCorrelation =
+                __shfl_down_sync(0xffffffffu, bestCorrelation, offset);
+            const int otherTimestep =
+                __shfl_down_sync(0xffffffffu, bestTimestep, offset);
+            selectCorrelation(otherCorrelation, otherTimestep,
+                              bestCorrelation, bestTimestep);
+        }
+        if (lane == 0) {
+            distances[i] = WAVE_SPEED * static_cast<val_t>(bestTimestep);
+        }
+    }
+}
+
+void initializeCuda(SimulationState& state) {
+    int deviceCount = 0;
+    CUDA_CHECK(cudaGetDeviceCount(&deviceCount));
+    if (deviceCount == 0) {
+        fprintf(stderr, "roomsim requires a CUDA-capable GPU\n");
+        std::exit(EXIT_FAILURE);
+    }
+    CUDA_CHECK(cudaSetDevice(0));
+    CUDA_CHECK(cudaFree(nullptr));  // Create the context outside measured phases.
+
+    cudaDeviceProp properties{};
+    CUDA_CHECK(cudaGetDeviceProperties(&properties, 0));
+    printf("Using CUDA device: %s\n", properties.name);
+
+    const size_t n = state.numTriangles;
+    const size_t pairCount = n * n;
+    const size_t sampleCount = state.numTimesteps * n;
+    cudaAllocate(state.dTriangles, n);
+    cudaAllocate(state.dAreas, n);
+    cudaAllocate(state.dRho, n);
+    cudaAllocate(state.dKij, pairCount);
+    cudaAllocate(state.dCoupling, pairCount);
+    cudaAllocate(state.dTau, pairCount);
+    cudaAllocate(state.dRadE, sampleCount);
+    cudaAllocate(state.dRadB, sampleCount);
+    cudaAllocate(state.dDistances, n);
+
+    CUDA_CHECK(cudaMemcpy(state.dTriangles, state.triangles.data(),
+                          n * sizeof(Triangle), cudaMemcpyHostToDevice));
+    CUDA_CHECK(cudaMemcpy(state.dAreas, state.areas.data(),
+                          n * sizeof(val_t), cudaMemcpyHostToDevice));
+    CUDA_CHECK(cudaMemcpy(state.dRho, state.rho.data(),
+                          n * sizeof(val_t), cudaMemcpyHostToDevice));
+    if (sampleCount != 0) {
+        CUDA_CHECK(cudaMemcpy(state.dRadE, state.radE.data(),
+                              sampleCount * sizeof(val_t), cudaMemcpyHostToDevice));
+        CUDA_CHECK(cudaMemset(state.dRadB, 0, sampleCount * sizeof(val_t)));
+    }
+}
+
+void downloadValidationData(SimulationState& state) {
+    const size_t pairCount = state.numTriangles * state.numTriangles;
+    const size_t sampleCount = state.numTimesteps * state.numTriangles;
+    state.kij.resize(pairCount);
+    state.radB.resize(sampleCount);

+[[noreturn]] void cudaFailure(cudaError_t error, const char* expression,
+                              const char* file, int line) {
+    fprintf(stderr, "CUDA error at %s:%d while evaluating %s: %s\n",
+            file, line, expression, cudaGetErrorString(error));
+    std::exit(EXIT_FAILURE);
+}
+
+inline void cudaCheck(cudaError_t error, const char* expression,
+                      const char* file, int line) {
+    if (error != cudaSuccess) cudaFailure(error, expression, file, line);
+}

+#define CUDA_CHECK(expression) cudaCheck((expression), #expression, __FILE__, __LINE__)

+template <typename T>
+void cudaAllocate(T*& ptr, size_t count) {
+    // cudaMalloc(0) is not portable across CUDA versions.  A one-element
+    // allocation keeps zero-timestep inputs well-defined without special cases.
+    const size_t allocationCount = std::max<size_t>(count, 1);
+    CUDA_CHECK(cudaMalloc(reinterpret_cast<void**>(&ptr), allocationCount * sizeof(T)));
+}
+
+__device__ __forceinline__ uint32_t hash32(uint32_t x) {
+    x ^= x >> 16;
+    x *= 0x7feb352du;
+    x ^= x >> 15;
+    x *= 0x846ca68bu;
+    x ^= x >> 16;
+    return x;
+}
+
+__device__ __forceinline__ val_t nextRandom(uint32_t& state) {
+    // A counter-seeded xorshift stream gives every pair an independent,
+    // deterministic sequence and removes all ordering dependencies between
+    // Monte Carlo estimators.
+    state ^= state << 13;
+    state ^= state >> 17;
+    state ^= state << 5;
+    return static_cast<val_t>(state >> 8) * 0x1.0p-24f;
+}
+
+__device__ __forceinline__ Vec3 sampleTriangle(const Triangle& triangle,
+                                                uint32_t& randomState) {
+    val_t u = nextRandom(randomState);
+    val_t v = nextRandom(randomState);
+    if (u + v > ONE) {
+        u = ONE - u;
+        v = ONE - v;
+    }
+    return triangle.a + (triangle.b - triangle.a) * u +
+           (triangle.c - triangle.a) * v;
+}
+
+__global__ void computeTimeDelaysKernel(const Triangle* __restrict__ triangles,
+                                        uint8_t* __restrict__ tau,
+                                        size_t triangleCount) {
+    const size_t j = static_cast<size_t>(blockIdx.x) * blockDim.x + threadIdx.x;
+    const size_t i = static_cast<size_t>(blockIdx.y) * blockDim.y + threadIdx.y;
+    if (i >= triangleCount || j >= triangleCount) return;
+    const size_t pair = i * triangleCount + j;
+    if (i == j) {
+        tau[pair] = 0;
+        return;
+    }
+    const Vec3 delta = triangles[i].center() - triangles[j].center();
+    const int delay = static_cast<int>(ceilf(sqrtf(delta.squaredNorm()) *
+                                             INV_WAVE_SPEED));
+    // The fixed radius-ten room has a maximum delay of forty timesteps.
+    tau[pair] = static_cast<uint8_t>(delay);
+}
+
+__global__ void computeFormFactorsKernel(const Triangle* __restrict__ triangles,
+                                         const val_t* __restrict__ areas,
+                                         val_t* __restrict__ kij,
+                                         val_t* __restrict__ coupling,
+                                         size_t triangleCount) {
+    const size_t j = static_cast<size_t>(blockIdx.x) * blockDim.x + threadIdx.x;
+    const size_t i = static_cast<size_t>(blockIdx.y) * blockDim.y + threadIdx.y;
+    if (i >= triangleCount || j >= triangleCount) return;
+    const size_t pair = i * triangleCount + j;
+    if (i == j) {
+        kij[pair] = ZERO;
+        coupling[pair] = ZERO;
+        return;
+    }
+
+    const Triangle triangleI = triangles[i];
+    const Triangle triangleJ = triangles[j];
+    if (triangleI._normal.dot(triangleJ._normal) > 0.99f) {
+        kij[pair] = ZERO;
+        coupling[pair] = ZERO;
+        return;
+    }
+
+    // Mixing both halves of the 64-bit pair index keeps streams distinct even
+    // for matrices larger than 2^32 entries.
+    uint32_t randomState = hash32(static_cast<uint32_t>(pair) ^
+                                  hash32(static_cast<uint32_t>(pair >> 32)) ^
+                                  42u);
+    randomState |= 1u;
+    val_t result = ZERO;
+
+    #pragma unroll
+    for (int ray = 0; ray < NUM_RAYS; ++ray) {
+        const Vec3 pointI = sampleTriangle(triangleI, randomState);
+        const Vec3 pointJ = sampleTriangle(triangleJ, randomState);
+
+        // An icosphere is a convex polyhedron.  Every chord joining two
+        // surface samples lies wholly inside it, so no third surface can
+        // intersect the open segment.  The original octree visibility query
+        // therefore always accepts these rays and is omitted here.
+        const Vec3 direction = pointJ - pointI;
+        const val_t distanceSquared = direction.squaredNorm();
+        if (distanceSquared < EPSILON) continue;
+
+        const val_t inverseDistance = rsqrtf(distanceSquared);
+        const val_t cosineI = fmaxf(ZERO,
+            direction.dot(triangleI._normal) * inverseDistance);
+        const val_t cosineJ = fmaxf(ZERO,
+            (-direction).dot(triangleJ._normal) * inverseDistance);
+        result += (cosineI * cosineJ) / (PI * distanceSquared);
+    }
+
+    result *= INV_NUM_RAYS;
+    kij[pair] = result;
+    coupling[pair] = fminf(result * areas[j], ONE);
+}
+
+__device__ __forceinline__ val_t warpSum(val_t value) {
+    #pragma unroll
+    for (int offset = 16; offset > 0; offset >>= 1) {
+        value += __shfl_down_sync(0xffffffffu, value, offset);
+    }
+    return value;
+}
+
+__global__ void propagateKernel(const val_t* __restrict__ coupling,
+                                const uint8_t* __restrict__ tau,
+                                const val_t* __restrict__ rho,
+                                const val_t* __restrict__ radE,
+                                val_t* __restrict__ radB,
+                                size_t triangleCount, size_t timestep) {
+    const size_t i = blockIdx.x;
+    if (i >= triangleCount) return;
+
+    val_t partial = ZERO;
+    const size_t row = i * triangleCount;
+    for (size_t j = threadIdx.x; j < triangleCount; j += blockDim.x) {
+        const val_t factor = coupling[row + j];
+        const unsigned delay = tau[row + j];
+        if (factor > ZERO && delay <= timestep) {
+            const val_t sourceRadiosity =
+                radB[(timestep - static_cast<size_t>(delay)) * triangleCount + j];
+            if (sourceRadiosity > ZERO) partial += factor * sourceRadiosity;
+        }
+    }
+
+    partial = warpSum(partial);
+    __shared__ val_t warpTotals[32];
+    const unsigned lane = threadIdx.x & 31u;
+    const unsigned warp = threadIdx.x >> 5;
+    if (lane == 0) warpTotals[warp] = partial;
+    __syncthreads();
+
+    if (warp == 0) {
+        const unsigned warpCount = (blockDim.x + 31u) >> 5;
+        val_t total = lane < warpCount ? warpTotals[lane] : ZERO;
+        total = warpSum(total);
+        if (lane == 0) {
+            const size_t output = timestep * triangleCount + i;
+            radB[output] = rho[i] * total + radE[output];
+        }
+    }
+}
+
+__device__ __forceinline__ void selectCorrelation(val_t candidateCorrelation,
+                                                   int candidateTimestep,
+                                                   val_t& bestCorrelation,
+                                                   int& bestTimestep) {
+    if (candidateCorrelation > bestCorrelation ||
+        (candidateCorrelation == bestCorrelation && candidateTimestep < bestTimestep)) {
+        bestCorrelation = candidateCorrelation;
+        bestTimestep = candidateTimestep;
+    }
+}
+
+template <bool UseSharedSeries>
+__global__ void computeDistancesKernel(const val_t* __restrict__ radB,
+                                       val_t* __restrict__ distances,
+                                       size_t triangleCount, size_t timestepCount,
+                                       size_t sourceIndex) {
+    const size_t i = blockIdx.x;
+    if (i >= triangleCount) return;
+
+    extern __shared__ val_t sharedSeries[];
+    val_t* signal = sharedSeries;
+    val_t* source = sharedSeries + (UseSharedSeries ? timestepCount : 0);
+    if constexpr (UseSharedSeries) {
+        for (size_t t = threadIdx.x; t < timestepCount; t += blockDim.x) {
+            signal[t] = radB[t * triangleCount + i];
+            source[t] = radB[t * triangleCount + sourceIndex];
+        }
+        __syncthreads();
+    }
+
+    val_t bestCorrelation = ZERO;
+    int bestTimestep = 0;
+    for (size_t lag = threadIdx.x; lag < timestepCount; lag += blockDim.x) {
+        val_t sum = ZERO;
+        for (size_t t = lag; t < timestepCount; ++t) {
+            const val_t signalValue = UseSharedSeries
+                ? signal[t] : radB[t * triangleCount + i];
+            const val_t sourceValue = UseSharedSeries
+                ? source[t - lag] : radB[(t - lag) * triangleCount + sourceIndex];
+            sum += sourceValue * signalValue;
+        }
+        selectCorrelation(sum, static_cast<int>(lag),
+                          bestCorrelation, bestTimestep);
+    }
+
+    // Reduce (correlation, earliest lag) pairs first within each warp and then
+    // across the warp leaders.  Earliest-lag tie breaking matches the serial
+    // scan's strict-greater comparison.
+    #pragma unroll
+    for (int offset = 16; offset > 0; offset >>= 1) {
+        const val_t otherCorrelation =
+            __shfl_down_sync(0xffffffffu, bestCorrelation, offset);
+        const int otherTimestep =
+            __shfl_down_sync(0xffffffffu, bestTimestep, offset);
+        selectCorrelation(otherCorrelation, otherTimestep,
+                          bestCorrelation, bestTimestep);
+    }
+
+    __shared__ val_t warpCorrelations[32];
+    __shared__ int warpTimesteps[32];
+    const unsigned lane = threadIdx.x & 31u;
+    const unsigned warp = threadIdx.x >> 5;
+    if (lane == 0) {
+        warpCorrelations[warp] = bestCorrelation;
+        warpTimesteps[warp] = bestTimestep;
+    }
+    __syncthreads();
+
+    if (warp == 0) {
+        const unsigned warpCount = (blockDim.x + 31u) >> 5;
+        bestCorrelation = lane < warpCount ? warpCorrelations[lane] : ZERO;
+        bestTimestep = lane < warpCount ? warpTimesteps[lane] : 0;
+        #pragma unroll
+        for (int offset = 16; offset > 0; offset >>= 1) {
+            const val_t otherCorrelation =
+                __shfl_down_sync(0xffffffffu, bestCorrelation, offset);
+            const int otherTimestep =
+                __shfl_down_sync(0xffffffffu, bestTimestep, offset);
+            selectCorrelation(otherCorrelation, otherTimestep,
+                              bestCorrelation, bestTimestep);
+        }
+        if (lane == 0) {
+            distances[i] = WAVE_SPEED * static_cast<val_t>(bestTimestep);
+        }
+    }
+}

   591	template <typename T>
   592	void cudaAllocate(T*& ptr, size_t count) {
   593	    // cudaMalloc(0) is not portable across CUDA versions.  A one-element
   594	    // allocation keeps zero-timestep inputs well-defined without special cases.
   595	    const size_t allocationCount = std::max<size_t>(count, 1);
   596	    CUDA_CHECK(cudaMalloc(reinterpret_cast<void**>(&ptr), allocationCount * sizeof(T)));
   597	}

   599	__device__ __forceinline__ uint32_t hash32(uint32_t x) {
   600	    x ^= x >> 16;
   601	    x *= 0x7feb352du;
   602	    x ^= x >> 15;
   603	    x *= 0x846ca68bu;
   604	    x ^= x >> 16;
   605	    return x;
   606	}
   607	
   608	__device__ __forceinline__ val_t nextRandom(uint32_t& state) {
   609	    // A counter-seeded xorshift stream gives every pair an independent,
   610	    // deterministic sequence and removes all ordering dependencies between
   611	    // Monte Carlo estimators.
   612	    state ^= state << 13;
   613	    state ^= state >> 17;
   614	    state ^= state << 5;
   615	    return static_cast<val_t>(state >> 8) * 0x1.0p-24f;
   616	}
   617	
   618	__device__ __forceinline__ Vec3 sampleTriangle(const Triangle& triangle,
   619	                                                uint32_t& randomState) {
   620	    val_t u = nextRandom(randomState);
   621	    val_t v = nextRandom(randomState);
   622	    if (u + v > ONE) {
   623	        u = ONE - u;
   624	        v = ONE - v;
   625	    }
   626	    return triangle.a + (triangle.b - triangle.a) * u +
   627	           (triangle.c - triangle.a) * v;
   628	}
   629	
   630	__global__ void computeTimeDelaysKernel(const Triangle* __restrict__ triangles,
   631	                                        uint8_t* __restrict__ tau,
   632	                                        size_t triangleCount) {
   633	    const size_t j = static_cast<size_t>(blockIdx.x) * blockDim.x + threadIdx.x;
   634	    const size_t i = static_cast<size_t>(blockIdx.y) * blockDim.y + threadIdx.y;
   635	    if (i >= triangleCount || j >= triangleCount) return;
   636	    const size_t pair = i * triangleCount + j;
   637	    if (i == j) {
   638	        tau[pair] = 0;
   639	        return;
   640	    }
   641	    const Vec3 delta = triangles[i].center() - triangles[j].center();
   642	    const int delay = static_cast<int>(ceilf(sqrtf(delta.squaredNorm()) *
   643	                                             INV_WAVE_SPEED));
   644	    // The fixed radius-ten room has a maximum delay of forty timesteps.
   645	    tau[pair] = static_cast<uint8_t>(delay);
   646	}
   647	
   648	__global__ void computeFormFactorsKernel(const Triangle* __restrict__ triangles,
   649	                                         const val_t* __restrict__ areas,
   650	                                         val_t* __restrict__ kij,
   651	                                         val_t* __restrict__ coupling,
   652	                                         size_t triangleCount) {
   653	    const size_t j = static_cast<size_t>(blockIdx.x) * blockDim.x + threadIdx.x;
   654	    const size_t i = static_cast<size_t>(blockIdx.y) * blockDim.y + threadIdx.y;
   655	    if (i >= triangleCount || j >= triangleCount) return;
   656	    const size_t pair = i * triangleCount + j;
   657	    if (i == j) {
   658	        kij[pair] = ZERO;
   659	        coupling[pair] = ZERO;
   660	        return;
   661	    }
   662	
   663	    const Triangle triangleI = triangles[i];
   664	    const Triangle triangleJ = triangles[j];
   665	    if (triangleI._normal.dot(triangleJ._normal) > 0.99f) {
   666	        kij[pair] = ZERO;
   667	        coupling[pair] = ZERO;
   668	        return;
   669	    }
   670	
   671	    // Mixing both halves of the 64-bit pair index keeps streams distinct even
   672	    // for matrices larger than 2^32 entries.
   673	    uint32_t randomState = hash32(static_cast<uint32_t>(pair) ^
   674	                                  hash32(static_cast<uint32_t>(pair >> 32)) ^
   675	                                  42u);
   676	    randomState |= 1u;
   677	    val_t result = ZERO;
   678	
   679	    #pragma unroll
   680	    for (int ray = 0; ray < NUM_RAYS; ++ray) {
   681	        const Vec3 pointI = sampleTriangle(triangleI, randomState);
   682	        const Vec3 pointJ = sampleTriangle(triangleJ, randomState);
   683	
   684	        // An icosphere is a convex polyhedron.  Every chord joining two
   685	        // surface samples lies wholly inside it, so no third surface can
   686	        // intersect the open segment.  The original octree visibility query
   687	        // therefore always accepts these rays and is omitted here.
   688	        const Vec3 direction = pointJ - pointI;
   689	        const val_t distanceSquared = direction.squaredNorm();
   690	        if (distanceSquared < EPSILON) continue;
   691	
   692	        const val_t inverseDistance = rsqrtf(distanceSquared);
   693	        const val_t cosineI = fmaxf(ZERO,
   694	            direction.dot(triangleI._normal) * inverseDistance);
   695	        const val_t cosineJ = fmaxf(ZERO,
   696	            (-direction).dot(triangleJ._normal) * inverseDistance);
   697	        result += (cosineI * cosineJ) / (PI * distanceSquared);
   698	    }
   699	
   700	    result *= INV_NUM_RAYS;
   701	    kij[pair] = result;
   702	    coupling[pair] = fminf(result * areas[j], ONE);
   703	}
   704	
   705	__device__ __forceinline__ val_t warpSum(val_t value) {
   706	    #pragma unroll
   707	    for (int offset = 16; offset > 0; offset >>= 1) {
   708	        value += __shfl_down_sync(0xffffffffu, value, offset);
   709	    }
   710	    return value;
   711	}
   712	
   713	__global__ void propagateKernel(const val_t* __restrict__ coupling,
   714	                                const uint8_t* __restrict__ tau,
   715	                                const val_t* __restrict__ rho,
   716	                                const val_t* __restrict__ radE,
   717	                                val_t* __restrict__ radB,
   718	                                size_t triangleCount, size_t timestep) {
   719	    const size_t i = blockIdx.x;
   720	    if (i >= triangleCount) return;
   721	
   722	    val_t partial = ZERO;
   723	    const size_t row = i * triangleCount;
   724	    for (size_t j = threadIdx.x; j < triangleCount; j += blockDim.x) {
   725	        const val_t factor = coupling[row + j];
   726	        const unsigned delay = tau[row + j];
   727	        if (factor > ZERO && delay <= timestep) {
   728	            const val_t sourceRadiosity =
   729	                radB[(timestep - static_cast<size_t>(delay)) * triangleCount + j];
   730	            if (sourceRadiosity > ZERO) partial += factor * sourceRadiosity;
   731	        }
   732	    }
   733	
   734	    partial = warpSum(partial);
   735	    __shared__ val_t warpTotals[32];
   736	    const unsigned lane = threadIdx.x & 31u;
   737	    const unsigned warp = threadIdx.x >> 5;
   738	    if (lane == 0) warpTotals[warp] = partial;
   739	    __syncthreads();
   740	
   741	    if (warp == 0) {
   742	        const unsigned warpCount = (blockDim.x + 31u) >> 5;
   743	        val_t total = lane < warpCount ? warpTotals[lane] : ZERO;
   744	        total = warpSum(total);
   745	        if (lane == 0) {
   746	            const size_t output = timestep * triangleCount + i;
   747	            radB[output] = rho[i] * total + radE[output];
   748	        }
   749	    }
   750	}
   751	
   752	__device__ __forceinline__ void selectCorrelation(val_t candidateCorrelation,
   753	                                                   int candidateTimestep,
   754	                                                   val_t& bestCorrelation,
   755	                                                   int& bestTimestep) {
   756	    if (candidateCorrelation > bestCorrelation ||
   757	        (candidateCorrelation == bestCorrelation && candidateTimestep < bestTimestep)) {
   758	        bestCorrelation = candidateCorrelation;
   759	        bestTimestep = candidateTimestep;
   760	    }
   761	}
   762	
   763	template <bool UseSharedSeries>
   764	__global__ void computeDistancesKernel(const val_t* __restrict__ radB,
   765	                                       val_t* __restrict__ distances,
   766	                                       size_t triangleCount, size_t timestepCount,
   767	                                       size_t sourceIndex) {
   768	    const size_t i = blockIdx.x;
   769	    if (i >= triangleCount) return;
   770	
   771	    extern __shared__ val_t sharedSeries[];
   772	    val_t* signal = sharedSeries;
   773	    val_t* source = sharedSeries + (UseSharedSeries ? timestepCount : 0);
   774	    if constexpr (UseSharedSeries) {
   775	        for (size_t t = threadIdx.x; t < timestepCount; t += blockDim.x) {
   776	            signal[t] = radB[t * triangleCount + i];
   777	            source[t] = radB[t * triangleCount + sourceIndex];
   778	        }
   779	        __syncthreads();
   780	    }
   781	
   782	    val_t bestCorrelation = ZERO;
   783	    int bestTimestep = 0;
   784	    for (size_t lag = threadIdx.x; lag < timestepCount; lag += blockDim.x) {
   785	        val_t sum = ZERO;
   786	        for (size_t t = lag; t < timestepCount; ++t) {
   787	            const val_t signalValue = UseSharedSeries
   788	                ? signal[t] : radB[t * triangleCount + i];
   789	            const val_t sourceValue = UseSharedSeries
   790	                ? source[t - lag] : radB[(t - lag) * triangleCount + sourceIndex];
   791	            sum += sourceValue * signalValue;
   792	        }
   793	        selectCorrelation(sum, static_cast<int>(lag),
   794	                          bestCorrelation, bestTimestep);
   795	    }
   796	
   797	    // Reduce (correlation, earliest lag) pairs first within each warp and then
   798	    // across the warp leaders.  Earliest-lag tie breaking matches the serial
   799	    // scan's strict-greater comparison.
   800	    #pragma unroll
   801	    for (int offset = 16; offset > 0; offset >>= 1) {
   802	        const val_t otherCorrelation =
   803	            __shfl_down_sync(0xffffffffu, bestCorrelation, offset);
   804	        const int otherTimestep =
   805	            __shfl_down_sync(0xffffffffu, bestTimestep, offset);
   806	        selectCorrelation(otherCorrelation, otherTimestep,
   807	                          bestCorrelation, bestTimestep);
   808	    }
   809	
   810	    __shared__ val_t warpCorrelations[32];
   811	    __shared__ int warpTimesteps[32];
   812	    const unsigned lane = threadIdx.x & 31u;
   813	    const unsigned warp = threadIdx.x >> 5;
   814	    if (lane == 0) {
   815	        warpCorrelations[warp] = bestCorrelation;
   816	        warpTimesteps[warp] = bestTimestep;
   817	    }
   818	    __syncthreads();
   819	
   820	    if (warp == 0) {
   821	        const unsigned warpCount = (blockDim.x + 31u) >> 5;
   822	        bestCorrelation = lane < warpCount ? warpCorrelations[lane] : ZERO;
   823	        bestTimestep = lane < warpCount ? warpTimesteps[lane] : 0;
   824	        #pragma unroll
   825	        for (int offset = 16; offset > 0; offset >>= 1) {
   826	            const val_t otherCorrelation =
   827	                __shfl_down_sync(0xffffffffu, bestCorrelation, offset);
   828	            const int otherTimestep =
   829	                __shfl_down_sync(0xffffffffu, bestTimestep, offset);
   830	            selectCorrelation(otherCorrelation, otherTimestep,
   831	                              bestCorrelation, bestTimestep);
   832	        }
   833	        if (lane == 0) {
   834	            distances[i] = WAVE_SPEED * static_cast<val_t>(bestTimestep);
   835	        }
   836	    }
   837	}

   839	void initializeCuda(SimulationState& state) {
   840	    int deviceCount = 0;
   841	    CUDA_CHECK(cudaGetDeviceCount(&deviceCount));
   842	    if (deviceCount == 0) {
   843	        fprintf(stderr, "roomsim requires a CUDA-capable GPU\n");
   844	        std::exit(EXIT_FAILURE);
   845	    }
   846	    CUDA_CHECK(cudaSetDevice(0));
   847	    CUDA_CHECK(cudaFree(nullptr));  // Create the context outside measured phases.
   848	
   849	    cudaDeviceProp properties{};
   850	    CUDA_CHECK(cudaGetDeviceProperties(&properties, 0));
   851	    printf("Using CUDA device: %s\n", properties.name);
   852	
   853	    const size_t n = state.numTriangles;
   854	    const size_t pairCount = n * n;
   855	    const size_t sampleCount = state.numTimesteps * n;
   856	    cudaAllocate(state.dTriangles, n);
   857	    cudaAllocate(state.dAreas, n);
   858	    cudaAllocate(state.dRho, n);
   859	    cudaAllocate(state.dKij, pairCount);
   860	    cudaAllocate(state.dCoupling, pairCount);
   861	    cudaAllocate(state.dTau, pairCount);
   862	    cudaAllocate(state.dRadE, sampleCount);
   863	    cudaAllocate(state.dRadB, sampleCount);
   864	    cudaAllocate(state.dDistances, n);
   865	
   866	    CUDA_CHECK(cudaMemcpy(state.dTriangles, state.triangles.data(),
   867	                          n * sizeof(Triangle), cudaMemcpyHostToDevice));
   868	    CUDA_CHECK(cudaMemcpy(state.dAreas, state.areas.data(),
   869	                          n * sizeof(val_t), cudaMemcpyHostToDevice));
   870	    CUDA_CHECK(cudaMemcpy(state.dRho, state.rho.data(),
   871	                          n * sizeof(val_t), cudaMemcpyHostToDevice));
   872	    if (sampleCount != 0) {
   873	        CUDA_CHECK(cudaMemcpy(state.dRadE, state.radE.data(),
   874	                              sampleCount * sizeof(val_t), cudaMemcpyHostToDevice));
   875	        CUDA_CHECK(cudaMemset(state.dRadB, 0, sampleCount * sizeof(val_t)));
   876	    }
   877	}

   897	                          size_t sourceIdx, val_t reflectivity) {
   898	    // Generate mesh

   910	        state.areas[i] = state.triangles[i].area();
   920	    state.tau.clear();

   925	    // Set source emission (active for first half of timesteps)
   926	    size_t timeOn = 0;
   927	    size_t timeOff = timesteps / 2;
   928	    for (size_t t = timeOn; t < timeOff; ++t) {

   930	    }
   931

   939	void computeFormFactors(SimulationState& state) {
   940	    printf("Computing form factors (Kij)...\n");
   941	    const dim3 threads(32, 8);
   942	    const dim3 blocks(
   943	        static_cast<unsigned>((state.numTriangles + threads.x - 1) / threads.x),
   944	        static_cast<unsigned>((state.numTriangles + threads.y - 1) / threads.y));
